items.prompt: For positions [0,10], velocities [3,1], what changes between horizons 4 and 5?

options.text: Both are SAFE because equality at the horizon is excluded.
options.why: The public condition includes a positive meeting exactly at t.

options.text: Both COLLIDE because the agents eventually meet.
options.why: A meeting after the specified horizon must not count yet.

options.text: Horizon 4 is SAFE; horizon 5 is COLLIDE.
options.why: The exact meeting time is 5 and the condition is tau<=t.

options.text: Horizon 4 is COLLIDE; horizon 5 is SAFE.
options.why: Expanding the horizon cannot remove this same positive meeting.
